name: dataset_app
label: Dataset
subtitle: Find open datasets and use them in a project with version, checksums and licence pinned
about: Search openly available datasets across OpenNeuro, DANDI, PhysioNet, GIN, Zenodo, Figshare, OpenML, HuggingFace, GEO, MoleculeNet, ChEMBL, ClinicalTrials.gov and pinned reference files. See a dataset's licence, size, files and how to cite it, copy a code snippet, and use it in your project: the version, DOI, file checksums and licence are recorded, and the files are fetched through a shared cache so a dataset is downloaded once.
description: SciTeX Dataset helps researchers find and use openly available datasets. One search covers every repository scitex-dataset supports; a dataset page shows metadata, files and sizes, licence, citation and a scitex snippet. 'Use in this project' records the dataset in .scitex/dataset/sources.json and can fetch it into project storage as a background job through the shared local cache, admitted by the host's storage quota and spend controls. The project page lists the public datasets in use with cache and verification state and, through a provider-neutral provenance contract, the scripts that read them. Curated AI-for-science datasets show their source, derivation chain and what is masked or held out.
ai_hint: Dataset app: search public datasets, see licence/citation/snippet, record a dataset in a project (sources.json) and fetch it via the shared cache, list the project's public datasets and which scripts read them, inspect curated AI-for-science datasets.
author: ywatanabe
capabilities: Search open datasets across 13 repositories with repository, domain, modality, size and licence filters
Dataset page with files, sizes, licence, citation and a code snippet
Record a dataset in a project with version, DOI, licence and file checksums
Fetch into project storage as a background job through the shared cache, within the host's quota
List the project's public datasets with cache state and the scripts that read them
Curated AI-for-science datasets: source, derivation chain and masking summary
